run_calc_gt_coco: run the script to calculate COCO format instance mask annotations for a BOP dataset scene
run_calc_gt_coco_modal_bbox: run the script with modal bounding box type to generate modal COCO annotations
run_calc_gt_coco_amodal_bbox: run the script with amodal bounding box type to generate amodal COCO annotations
review_calc_gt_coco: review the script that converts BOP ground truth poses and masks into COCO JSON annotations
summarize_calc_gt_coco: summarize how the script loads scene ground truth, camera data, and masks to produce COCO output
